description: Curriculum topic taxonomy reference catalog for SLIIT Third-Year Software Engineering modules.

topics.reference_text: Structured Query Language formulation including data definition, table schema creation, primary and foreign key constraints, single-table and multi-table inner and outer joins, grouping and aggregate calculations with HAVING clauses, nested and correlated subqueries, common table expressions (CTEs), and analytical window functions.

subtopics: Index Maintenance and Disk I/O Overhead
topics.reference_text: Database indexing data structures and access methods including balanced search trees, B-trees and B+ trees, clustered versus non-clustered organization, primary and secondary indexes, composite multi-attribute indexing, covering indexes for index-only scans, hash and bitmap indexes, leaf node traversal, and disk I/O performance trade-offs.

subtopics: First Normal Form (1NF) and Second Normal Form (2NF)
Third Normal Form (3NF) and Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF)
topics.reference_text: Relational schema design and normalization theory based on functional dependencies, candidate keys, and superkeys. Elimination of insertion, update, and deletion anomalies through step-wise decomposition into 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, and BCNF, while verifying lossless-join decomposition and dependency preservation guarantees.

Transaction processing, concurrency control, and database crash recovery. Enforcing ACID guarantees, conflict serializability, preventing dirty reads, unrepeatable reads, and phantom reads across ANSI isolation levels. Implementation of Two-Phase Locking (2PL, S2PL), deadlock prevention and detection, and write-ahead logging (WAL) with undo/redo recovery algorithms.

subtopics: Join Algorithms (Nested Loop, Hash Join, Merge Join)
Query Execution Plans and Cost Estimation
topics.reference_text: Query evaluation and optimization pipelines in relational database management systems. Algebraic equivalence transformations, heuristic optimization pushing selections and projections down the operator tree, cost-based evaluation of join algorithms including nested loops, sort-merge, and hash joins, and interpreting explain query execution plans.

Comprehensive analysis of real-world software engineering case studies. Scoping system boundaries, identifying primary and secondary actors and stakeholders, eliciting functional and non-functional requirements, developing use case models with include and extend relationships, and establishing domain entities and business rules.

Structural and behavioral object-oriented system modeling using Unified Modeling Language (UML). Construction of conceptual and design class diagrams specifying associations, aggregations, compositions, inheritance hierarchies, and multiplicities. Modeling dynamic states with state machine diagrams and activity diagrams to justify design decisions.

Detailed interaction modeling using UML sequence diagrams. Depicting runtime communication flows across object lifelines, activation bars, synchronous method invocations, asynchronous event dispatches, reply signals, and structuring conditional and repetitive logic with combined fragments (alt, opt, loop, par).

Selection, implementation, and evaluation of Gang of Four (GoF) software design patterns to solve recurring object-oriented architectural problems. Applying creational patterns (Singleton, Factory, Builder), structural patterns (Adapter, Decorator, Facade), and behavioral patterns (Observer, Strategy, Command) to achieve high cohesion and loose coupling.

subtopics: Refactoring Techniques and Clean Code Practices
topics.reference_text: Critical evaluation of software architectures against quality attributes. Detecting structural code smells, architectural antipatterns (God Class, Spaghetti Code, Shotgun Surgery), technical debt accumulation, and applying disciplined refactoring transformations to improve system maintainability, readability, and extensibility.

subtopics: Net Present Value (NPV) and Discounted Cash Flow
Payback Period and Return on Investment (ROI)
topics.reference_text: Project evaluation, appraisal, and selection methodologies in software engineering. Quantitative financial models including cost-benefit analysis, discounted cash flows, Net Present Value (NPV), Payback Period, Return on Investment (ROI), Internal Rate of Return (IRR), and qualitative multi-criteria scoring models for strategic portfolio decisions.

subtopics: Risk Identification and Risk Breakdown Structure
Risk Response Strategies (Avoid, Transfer, Mitigate, Accept)
Earned Value Management (EVM - PV, EV, AC, CPI, SPI)
topics.reference_text: Software project risk governance and monitoring frameworks. Comprehensive risk management workflows including risk identification, probability-impact matrix assessment, and response strategies (mitigation, avoidance, transfer, acceptance). Progress tracking using Earned Value Management (EVM) metrics including Planned Value (PV), Earned Value (EV), Actual Cost (AC), CPI, and SPI.

topics.topic_name: Activity Scheduling and Critical Path Analysis
subtopics: Critical Path Method (CPM) and Forward/Backward Passes
Total Float and Free Float Calculation
topics.reference_text: Activity network planning and scheduling techniques for software engineering projects. Constructing precedence diagrams (PDM), executing forward and backward passes to compute early and late start/finish dates, identifying the Critical Path (CPM), calculating total and free float/slack, and probabilistic scheduling via PERT three-point estimation.

subtopics: Constructive Cost Model (COCOMO and COCOMO II)
Function Point Analysis (FPA) and Complexity Weighting
Agile Story Points and Planning Poker
topics.reference_text: Software size, effort, and cost estimation methodologies. Hierarchical Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) decomposition, algorithmic estimation models like COCOMO and COCOMO II based on KLOC and cost drivers, Function Point Analysis (FPA) factoring data and transaction functions, and Agile empirical estimation using Story Points and Planning Poker.

topics.topic_name: Agile Project Governance and Sprint Management
subtopics: Sprint Planning, Execution, and Velocity Tracking
topics.reference_text: Agile software project management principles and execution practices. Implementing the Scrum framework across roles (Product Owner, Scrum Master, Developers), ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Standup, Review, Retrospective), and artifacts (Backlogs, Burn-down charts). Tracking team velocity, managing Work-in-Progress (WIP) in Kanban, and upholding the Definition of Done.

subtopics: User Interviews, Surveys, and Contextual Inquiry
Empathy Mapping and Customer Journey Mapping
Problem Framing and User Need Identification
topics.reference_text: User-centered research and Design Thinking methodologies for interactive systems. Conducting generative user interviews, surveys, and contextual observations; synthesizing findings into empirical user personas and empathy maps; charting customer journey maps to uncover pain points, unmet needs, and framing design opportunities.

subtopics: Task Decomposition into Subtasks and Operations
HTA Plans and Conditional Execution Logic
Cognitive Load Assessment and Error Analysis
topics.reference_text: Structured cognitive task analysis and modeling techniques. Decomposing high-level user goals into hierarchical subtasks and primitive operations using Hierarchical Task Analysis (HTA) with explicit sequential and conditional plans. Predicting execution times and cognitive bottlenecks using GOMS and Keystroke-Level Models (KLM).

subtopics: Heuristic Evaluation Methodology and Severity Rating
System Usability Scale (SUS) and Usability Metrics
keywords: match between system and real world
topics.reference_text: Empirical and discount usability evaluation methods. Applying Jakob Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics to conduct systematic expert reviews with severity grading. Designing and running moderated usability test sessions using think-aloud protocols, cognitive walkthroughs, and computing standardized usability scores such as the System Usability Scale (SUS).

subtopics: Design Systems, Grid Systems, and Component Guidelines
topics.reference_text: Iterative user interface prototyping and interaction design specifications. Developing low-fidelity paper prototypes and wireframes to establish information architecture and navigation flows. Elevating designs to high-fidelity clickable mockups incorporating affordances, visual signifiers, feedback loops, and consistent design system components.

subtopics: Color Contrast Ratios and Visual Accessibility
WAI-ARIA Roles and Screen Reader Optimization
topics.reference_text: Universal and accessible interface engineering adhering to W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1/2.2). Implementing the POUR principles (Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust), ensuring compliant color contrast ratios, full keyboard navigability with visible focus indicators, and semantics via WAI-ARIA roles for screen readers.

subtopics: REST Architectural Principles and Resource Modeling
HTTP Verbs (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) and Status Codes
Routing, Controllers, and Parameter Handling in Express/Spring
Content Negotiation, Request Validation, and Response Formatting
topics.reference_text: Modern web backend development and RESTful Web Service architecture. Designing stateless resource-oriented APIs following HTTP specification standards, implementing controllers, routing mechanisms in Express.js and Spring Boot, constructing reusable middleware pipelines for logging, validation, and request preprocessing.

subtopics: Stack Trace Analysis and Root Cause Identification
Logging Strategies (Winston, Morgan) and Structured Telemetry
Debugging Lifecycle Hooks, State Transitions, and Breakpoints
Dependency Conflict and Runtime Error Resolution
topics.reference_text: Diagnostic workflows, telemetry, and debugging strategies across full-stack application frameworks. Analyzing call stacks, unhandled promise rejections, memory leaks, implementing centralized error-handling middleware, configuring structured application logging, and diagnosing build, bundling, and dependency issues.

topics.topic_name: Full-Stack State Management and Data Binding
subtopics: Global State Stores (Redux, Context API, Zustand)
Unidirectional Data Flow vs Two-Way Data Binding
Form State Management and Controlled Components
topics.reference_text: Client-side state architecture and data synchronization in modern Single Page Applications (SPAs). Managing local state with modern React Hooks, orchestrating predictable global state via Redux or Context API, optimizing component re-rendering through memoization, and handling complex form data binding.

subtopics: JSON Web Tokens (JWT) Structure, Signing, and Verification
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Permission Guards
Common Web Vulnerability Defense (CORS, CSRF, XSS, Helmet)
topics.reference_text: Application security, identity management, and access control in distributed web services. Implementing stateless authentication using cryptographically signed JSON Web Tokens (JWT), robust password hashing algorithms, enforcing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) via security middleware, and defending against CORS, CSRF, and XSS exploits.

subtopics: JavaScript Event Loop, Microtasks, and Macrotasks
Promises, async/await, and Asynchronous Error Handling
topics.reference_text: Non-blocking concurrency and asynchronous programming paradigms. Internal mechanics of the Node.js event loop, call stack, and task queues; mastering Promises and async/await control flow; event-driven programming via EventEmitter and streaming data pipes; and establishing real-time full-duplex communication with WebSockets.

subtopics: Remote Procedure Calls (RPC) and gRPC Framework
topics.reference_text: Inter-process communication protocols and architectures in distributed computing environments. Synchronous Remote Procedure Calls (RPC, gRPC) with schema-based binary Protocol Buffers serialization; asynchronous message-oriented architectures utilizing publish-subscribe message brokers like Kafka and RabbitMQ.

subtopics: Circuit Breaker Pattern and Retry with Exponential Backoff
topics.reference_text: Techniques for achieving dependability, resilience, and fault tolerance across distributed nodes. Classifying failure modes (crash-stop, omission, Byzantine faults), resilient communication patterns including Circuit Breaker and Exponential Backoff, heartbeat failure detectors, active-passive redundancy, and establishing idempotent operations.

subtopics: Service Registries and Health Checking (Consul, Eureka)
Load Balancing Algorithms (Round Robin, Least Connections)
API Gateways and Reverse Proxy Architectures
topics.reference_text: Dynamic routing, discovery, and traffic management in distributed microservices. Comparing client-side and server-side service discovery with centralized registries like Consul and Eureka; load balancing algorithms including round-robin, least connections, and consistent hashing for optimal cluster utilization.

subtopics: Two-Phase Commit (2PC) and Atomic Commit Protocols
Raft Consensus Algorithm (Leader Election, Log Replication)
Quorum Consensus and State Machine Replication
topics.reference_text: Distributed agreement, atomic commitment, and data replication across asynchronous networks. Navigating the CAP theorem and PACELC trade-offs; coordination via Two-Phase Commit (2PC); leader election and distributed log replication using modern consensus protocols including Raft and Paxos, with quorum state machines.

subtopics: Cache Eviction Policies (LRU, LFU) and Invalidation
topics.reference_text: Scalable in-memory data storage and partitioning strategies for high-throughput distributed applications. Implementing cache-aside, write-through, and write-behind patterns with Redis; managing cache invalidation and stampedes; horizontal sharding and consistent hashing to minimize data movement during node scaling.

subtopics: Hexagonal Architecture (Ports and Adapters) / Clean Architecture
topics.reference_text: Foundational software architectural styles and structural paradigms. Analyzing architectural trade-offs between monolithic and microservice architectures, layered N-tier organization, event-driven reactive messaging, and domain-centric Hexagonal (Ports and Adapters) and Clean Architecture patterns.

subtopics: Kruchten 4+1 View Model of Software Architecture
UML Deployment Diagrams and Execution Architecture
topics.reference_text: Formal visualization and documentation of complex software architectures. Applying the C4 model across System Context, Container, Component, and Code levels; modeling concurrent, physical, and logical perspectives via Kruchten's 4+1 View Model; and capturing key architectural rationale using Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

subtopics: Quality Attribute Scenario Formulation (Stimulus, Source, Response)
Availability, Fault Detection, and Recovery Tactics
topics.reference_text: Specifying and achieving non-functional system properties through structured Quality Attribute Scenarios (specifying source, stimulus, artifact, environment, response, and response measure). Implementing architectural tactics to engineer availability, scalability, latency, modifiability, and security into systems.

subtopics: Utility Tree Development and Scenario Prioritization
Sensitivity Points, Tradeoff Points, and Risk Themes
topics.reference_text: Systematic evaluation and review of proposed software architectures prior to implementation. Executing the Architecture Tradeoff Analysis Method (ATAM), constructing utility trees to prioritize high-risk scenarios, analyzing sensitivity points and tradeoff points where quality attributes conflict, and mitigating architectural drift.

subtopics: Decomposition by Business Capability vs Subdomain
API Gateway and Backend for Frontend (BFF) Pattern
topics.reference_text: Decomposition strategies for distributed microservice architectures. Identifying clean service boundaries using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) strategic design and Bounded Contexts; managing distributed cross-service transactions using the Saga pattern (choreography and orchestration), and applying API Gateways and BFF patterns.

modules.module_name: Software Engineering Process and Quality Management

subtopics: Decision Table Testing for Complex Business Rules
State Transition Testing and State Tables
Use Case Testing and Scenario Derivation
topics.reference_text: Black-box and specification-based software testing techniques. Formulating rigorous test suites using Equivalence Partitioning (identifying valid and invalid equivalence classes), Boundary Value Analysis (BVA testing on, above, and below boundary limits), Decision Table testing for combinatorial rules, and State Transition testing.

subtopics: Cyclomatic Complexity (McCabe) and Basis Path Testing
topics.reference_text: White-box structural testing and code coverage analysis. Constructing Control Flow Graphs (CFG) from source code, calculating McCabe's Cyclomatic Complexity to determine linearly independent execution paths for Basis Path Testing, and measuring Statement, Branch, Condition, and MC/DC coverage criteria.

topics.topic_name: Software Quality Metrics and Defect Tracking
subtopics: Defect Density and Defect Removal Efficiency (DRE)
Object-Oriented Metrics (Chidamber & Kemerer - CBO, WMC, LCOM)
Static Code Analysis Rules and Technical Debt Ratio
Mean Time to Failure (MTTF) and Reliability Metrics
topics.reference_text: Measurement, tracking, and governance of software quality and defects. Calculating Defect Density, Defect Removal Efficiency (DRE), and reliability metrics (MTTF, MTTR). Applying object-oriented design metrics (Chidamber and Kemerer CBO, LCOM, WMC), static code inspection, and tracking defects through their lifecycle.

topics.topic_name: Software Process Models and Agile Quality Assurance
subtopics: Sequential vs Iterative Lifecycle Models (V-Model, Spiral)
Formal Peer Reviews, Walkthroughs, and Fagan Inspections
topics.reference_text: Software development life cycle processes, maturity frameworks, and quality standards. Comparing V-Model verification/validation and Spiral risk management; assessing organizational maturity via CMMI levels 1 through 5; evaluating product quality using ISO/IEC 25010; and executing formal Fagan inspections and Test-Driven Development (TDD).

subtopics: Continuous Integration (CI) and Automated Regression Testing
User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Release Sign-Off
topics.reference_text: Multi-tier integration, system testing, and automated release strategies. Comparing Big Bang, Top-Down (using stubs), Bottom-Up (using drivers), and Sandwich integration; maintaining continuous automated regression test suites within CI/CD pipelines; and conducting performance, stress, load, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
